name: adventurer-guide
author: rhewid
description: An Adventurer Guide NPC in Prontera (136,171) that reads your class and level. It tells you where to level, with a hunting tip for your class at every spot; what gear to buy from NPCs and which gear and cards to farm (with prices, drop rates and maps); stat and skill builds with several playstyles per class; MVPs that could be worth a try with the boss skills to watch for; and this server's EXP and drop rates. Pre-renewal and renewal each use their own data, taken from the server's own item, monster and shop tables.
